import numpy as np

# Compare memory footprint: standard vs FlashAttention
seq_lengths = [512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768]
num_heads = 32
head_dim = 128
dtype_bytes = 2  # float16

print(f"{'Seq Len':>8} | {'Standard (MB)':>14} | {'Flash (MB)':>12} | {'Savings':>8}")
print("-" * 52)

for N in seq_lengths:
    # Standard: must store full N x N attention matrix per head
    standard_mb = num_heads * N * N * dtype_bytes / (1024 ** 2)
    # FlashAttention: only O(N) — stores KV + output, no attn matrix
    flash_mb = num_heads * N * head_dim * 2 * dtype_bytes / (1024 ** 2)  # Q,K,V,O
    savings = (1 - flash_mb / standard_mb) * 100
    print(f"{N:>8} | {standard_mb:>12.1f}  | {flash_mb:>10.1f}  | {savings:>6.1f}%")

import numpy as np

def standard_attention(Q, K, V):
    """Standard attention: materializes full N x N matrix."""
    scores = Q @ K.T                    # O(N^2) memory
    weights = np.exp(scores - scores.max(axis=-1, keepdims=True))
    weights /= weights.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    return weights @ V                  # another O(N^2) read

def tiled_attention(Q, K, V, block_size=64):
    """FlashAttention-style: never materializes full matrix."""
    N, d = Q.shape
    O = np.zeros_like(V)
    l = np.zeros(N)  # running softmax denominator
    m = np.full(N, -np.inf)  # running max
    
    for j in range(0, N, block_size):
        Kj = K[j:j+block_size]
        Vj = V[j:j+block_size]
        
        # Compute block scores — only block_size columns at a time
        scores_j = Q @ Kj.T  # N x block_size, NOT N x N
        
        # Online softmax update
        m_new = np.maximum(m, scores_j.max(axis=-1))
        exp_scores = np.exp(scores_j - m_new[:, None])
        l_new = np.exp(m - m_new) * l + exp_scores.sum(axis=-1)
        
        # Rescale previous output and add new contribution
        O = O * (np.exp(m - m_new) * l / l_new)[:, None]
        O += (exp_scores / l_new[:, None]) @ Vj
        
        m, l = m_new, l_new
    
    return O

# Verify correctness
np.random.seed(42)
N, d = 256, 64
Q = np.random.randn(N, d).astype(np.float32)
K = np.random.randn(N, d).astype(np.float32)
V = np.random.randn(N, d).astype(np.float32)

out_standard = standard_attention(Q, K, V)
out_tiled = tiled_attention(Q, K, V, block_size=64)

max_diff = np.max(np.abs(out_standard - out_tiled))
print(f"Max difference: {max_diff:.2e}")
print(f"Outputs match: {max_diff < 1e-5}")
print(f"\nStandard peak memory: {N}x{N} = {N*N:,} elements")
print(f"Tiled peak memory: {N}x64 = {N*64:,} elements")
print(f"Memory reduction: {N*N / (N*64):.0f}x")

import numpy as np

def stft_windowed(signal, window_size=256, hop=128):
    """Short-Time Fourier Transform: tile the signal, FFT each tile."""
    n_frames = (len(signal) - window_size) // hop + 1
    window = np.hanning(window_size)
    # Each frame fits in 'fast memory' — no full-signal FFT needed
    spectrogram = np.zeros((n_frames, window_size // 2 + 1))
    for i in range(n_frames):
        frame = signal[i * hop : i * hop + window_size] * window
        spectrogram[i] = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(frame))
    return spectrogram

# Generate a chirp signal (frequency sweeps up over time)
sr = 16000
t = np.linspace(0, 2, sr * 2)
signal = np.sin(2 * np.pi * (200 + 1800 * t / 4) * t)

# Full FFT: one shot, loses all time information
full_fft = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(signal))

# STFT: tiled processing, preserves time + frequency
spec = stft_windowed(signal, window_size=512, hop=256)

print(f"Signal length: {len(signal):,} samples")
print(f"\nFull FFT approach:")
print(f"  Peak memory: {len(signal):,} complex elements (all at once)")
print(f"  Output: {len(full_fft):,} frequency bins (no time axis)")
print(f"\nSTFT tiled approach:")
print(f"  Peak memory: 512 elements per tile (window_size)")
print(f"  Output: {spec.shape[0]} frames x {spec.shape[1]} freq bins")
print(f"  Memory ratio: {len(signal) / 512:.0f}x less per operation")
print(f"\n-- Same tradeoff as FlashAttention --")
print(f"  Full attention: materialize NxN = {len(signal)**2/1e6:.0f}M elements")
print(f"  Tiled attention: Nx{512} = {len(signal)*512/1e6:.1f}M per block")
